title: Bacterial Isolate Genomic DNA Isolation - ONT NO-MISS
author: Carlos Carlos Goller
materials: Combine the following reagents with your sample in the 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube and mix by vortexing.

Extractions performed using the CTAB buffer improves sequencing health and output compared to using NEB Lysis Buffer from the Monarch Spin gDNA Extraction Kit. IMPORTANT: The full 30-minute incubation must be completed to ensure the proteinase and RNase activity occurs, regardless of turbidity. 00:30:00
Combine the following reagents in a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube:
The gDNA spin column can be discarded.

steps.title: Inoculate liquid culture in TSB
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony of each isolate and inoculate into 5 mL Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB) in a sterile tube.

steps.title: Grow cultures with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes with shaking at 30 °C for 16–18 hours.

steps.title: Reconstitute lysozyme in TE
steps.instruction: Reconstitute lysozyme in TE buffer to a concentration of 10 mg mL⁻¹; prepare fresh on the day of use.

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of the overnight culture (≈1 × 10⁸–10⁹ cfu mL⁻¹) or 1/8 of a 10 µL loop of colonies into a fresh 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube and centrifuge at 12 000 × g, 20 °C, 1 min.

steps.title: Wash pellet with PBS
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant by pipetting, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), then centrifuge again at 12 000 × g, 20 °C, 1 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in lysis buffer
steps.instruction:
Discard the PBS supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 µL of the appropriate lysis buffer:
• For most bacteria: 100 µL TE buffer + 10 µL lysozyme (10 mg mL⁻¹).
• For staphylococcal samples: 100 µL Staphylococcal Lysis Buffer (SLB) + 10 µL achromopeptidase, removing as much PBS as possible to avoid inhibition.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at 37 °C for 10 min in a thermomixer set to 500 rpm. If a thermomixer is unavailable, incubate stationary and flick the tube gently for 10 s every 2 min.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL CTAB buffer to the lysate and mix thoroughly by vortexing to ensure complete dispersion of the viscous mixture.

steps.title: Incubate at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 56 °C for 30 min in a thermomixer set to 1000 rpm.

steps.title: Preheat elution buffer to 60 °C
steps.instruction: Place the Monarch® gDNA Elution Buffer in a heat block and pre‑heat to 60 °C for later use; the 2 : 1 binding‑buffer‑to‑lysate ratio is critical for column binding efficiency.

steps.title: Mix lysate with binding buffer
steps.instruction: Take 200 µL of the lysate and add 400 µL Monarch® gDNA Binding Buffer (maintaining the 2 : 1 ratio). Mix gently by pipetting until the solution is homogeneous.

steps.title: Bind DNA on spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a Monarch® Spin Column placed in its collection tube (avoid touching the column matrix). Centrifuge at 1 000 × g, 20 °C, 3 min to bind DNA, then without removing the tube centrifuge at >12 000 × g (≈16 000 rpm), 20 °C, 1 min to clear the membrane. Do not empty or remove the collection tube between spins.

steps.title: Wash column – first wash
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through tube, place the spin column into a new collection tube, add 500 µL Monarch® gDNA Wash Buffer (do NOT vortex), close the tube and invert repeatedly until the buffer reaches the cap. Centrifuge at >12 000 × g (≈16 000 rpm), 20 °C, 1 min. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column – second wash
steps.instruction: Re‑insert the spin column into the same collection tube, add another 500 µL Wash Buffer, close, and centrifuge at >12 000 × g (≈16 000 rpm), 20 °C, 1 min. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column and verify no liquid
steps.instruction: After the second wash, spin the column briefly (≥12 000 × g, 20 °C, 1 min) until no liquid remains above or below the silica membrane; repeat if any liquid is observed.

steps.title: Elute DNA with preheated buffer
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a DNase‑free 1.5 mL microfuge tube, add 100 µL pre‑heated (60 °C) Monarch® gDNA Elution Buffer, close, and incubate at room temperature for 1 min. Centrifuge at >12 000 × g (≈16 000 rpm), 20 °C, 1 min to collect the eluate. (If higher concentration is needed, ≤100 µL elution buffer may be used, but <50 µL is not recommended.)

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Take 1 µL of the eluted DNA and measure concentration on a Qubit fluorometer; expected yield is ~15–20 ng µL⁻¹ with a DNA Integrity Number (DIN) of 9.

steps.title: Store DNA and proceed to library prep
steps.instruction: Aliquot the DNA and store frozen at –30 °C to –15 °C (or –90 °C to –65 °C). Use 200 ng per sample for the Nanopore‑only Microbial Isolate Sequencing Solution (NO‑MISS) Rapid Barcoding Kit (SQK‑RBK114.24 or SQK‑RBK114.96) in the subsequent library‑preparation step.
